start: ^I built an admin content management system that allows the church staff to set and schedule daily Bible verses directly inside the game.
^Want me to go into more technical detail?
technical_detail: ^I made this one with Laravel Filament and hosted through Hostinger.
^I connected an external admin dashboard that communicates with our Unity Cloud through API.
^Church admins can set and schedule daily verses in this web app.
^As well as quizzes and their answers, turning them on or off depending on what quizzes they want active.
^This ensures that all players concurrently receive the exact same scheduled daily verse or quizzes!
^I also added a fallback feature so that if the church does not manually set a verse for the day, the game automatically selects a randomized one for the players.
